faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the trial

items.title: Do I need to set anything technical up myself?
items.desc: No. You just forward your existing business number to the number we assign you — we set up everything else together with you on the onboarding call.

items.title: How much can I test during the trial?
items.desc: The free minutes cover inbound calls and widget conversations during the 7 days. Outbound calling is an add-on with its own free trial.

items.title: Can I upgrade before the trial ends?
items.desc: Yes. At any point during the 7 days you can add a paid package and continue seamlessly, without starting over.

items.title: Is there any commitment or hidden costs?
items.desc: No, the trial is completely non-binding. If you choose not to continue, access simply ends after the 7 days.
